description: Search for Hearthstone cards by name, text, class, mana cost, type, rarity, set, or keyword. Use this when you need to find cards matching specific criteria. Returns a summary list — use get_card for full details on a specific card.

card_set.description: Filter by set code (e.g. CORE, CLASSIC, LOE)

cost_op.description: Cost comparison operator: eq, lt, lte, gt, gte (default: eq)

keyword.description: Filter by keyword in keywords JSON (e.g. BATTLECRY, TAUNT, CHARGE)

mana_cost.description: Filter by mana cost (combine with cost_op for range queries)

player_class.description: Filter by class (e.g. MAGE, WARRIOR, NEUTRAL)

query.description: Free-text search across card name and text (uses FTS5)

race.description: Filter by minion race/tribe (e.g. BEAST, DRAGON, MURLOC)

rarity.description: Filter by rarity: FREE, COMMON, RARE, EPIC, LEGENDARY

type.description: Filter by card type: MINION, SPELL, WEAPON, HERO, LOCATION

name: search_cards
